text.div: MedFlow Guardian supports a constrained FHIR R4 export and Consent-import interface. It is not a general FHIR CRUD server.

name: MedFlowGuardianR4CapabilityStatement
title: MedFlow Guardian FHIR R4 Capability Statement
description: FHIR R4 export and Consent-import capabilities implemented by MedFlow. This is not a general-purpose FHIR CRUD server.

rest.documentation: Capability metadata is public. Patient export requires MedFlow bearer authentication and central authorization. Consent import uses the custom /fhir/consents/import endpoint. No standard FHIR search, history, update, delete, transaction, batch, or Binary endpoint is claimed.

security.description: MedFlow bearer JWT plus role, organization, relationship, consent, purpose, operation, and time checks. CORS uses explicit trusted origins.

resource.documentation: Collection Bundle returned by the authorized patient export operation.
Export-only patient representation inside an authorized Bundle.
Referenced/exported practitioner identity; no standalone CRUD endpoint.
Referenced/exported organization identity; no standalone FHIR CRUD endpoint.
A fail-closed R4 subset is accepted only at the documented custom import endpoint.
